subject: Compliance artifacts: Drive transfer schedule & screenshot redaction plan
messages:
From: Tom Weller <tweller@crescenthealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@crescenthealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: artifact delivery & redaction confirmation for SIG

Neha —

Thanks for taking this on. Crescent Health's security team has completed the SIG questionnaire and now needs the supporting artifacts to validate a few controls (primarily A.2 access control, A.6 network diagrams, and evidence for key rotation). Our review deadline is EOD Friday, Dec 3.

What we need from Redwood:
- Drive links to the policy and runbook artifacts (access control, KMS rotation runbook)
- Network diagram(s) with component labels and VPC/subnet boundaries
- Screenshots of IAM console showing roles/policies (redacted for IPs/hostnames is fine)
- A manifest file describing what was delivered and any redactions applied

Please confirm: is it OK to receive a redacted screenshot bundle and a separate redaction manifest indicating what was removed/modified? Also let us know if any items are on a different cadence (e.g., SOC evidence that requires additional time).

Cc'd the security inbox for visibility.

Appreciate a brief plan and ETA.

—Tom
Tom Weller
Senior Security Analyst, Crescent Health

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Weller <tweller@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: artifact delivery & redaction confirmation for SIG

Tom —

Thanks — we can do that. Quick plan below and an ETA for each item. If anything needs to be unredacted for reviewers with a signed NDA, tell me and we can route via the private folder.

Planned deliverables and ETA:
- Access control runbook (PDF) — upload to Drive by Tue, Dec 1 18:00 PT.
- KMS rotation runbook (PDF) — upload by Wed, Dec 2 12:00 PT.
- Network diagram (PNG + editable source) — upload by Tue, Dec 1 18:00 PT.
- Screenshot bundle (redacted ZIP) + redaction_manifest.csv — upload by Wed, Dec 2 17:00 PT.
- Artifact manifest (CSV) listing filenames, owners, and redactions — upload with the bundle.

Redaction approach: we will remove/blur external IPs and hostnames and replace them with placeholders (e.g., [REDACTED-BY-IP]). IAM role names and policy IDs will be preserved when they are purely logical identifiers; we will redact any customer-specific tenant IDs. We will include a redaction_manifest.csv that lists original filename, redaction type, and reason.

Interim links (work-in-progress):
- Drive folder (private share link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdE_example_folder
- Network diagram draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NetworkDiagramExample/view

A couple quick clarifying Qs:
1) For screenshots, do you want separate screenshots per audit control (e.g., IAM->roles, KMS keys, cloud audit config) or grouped by subsystem?
2) For any items that reference internal hostnames, is a hashed identifier acceptable instead of a full hostname?

I'll upload the first batch (runbook + diagram) by end of day Tuesday and update this thread. Marissa — can you help with creating the redaction_manifest and doing the screenshots? Karthik — please prepare the network diagram nodes with component labels.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tom Weller <tweller@crescenthealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, security_ops@crescenthealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: artifact delivery & redaction confirmation for SIG

Neha —

Thanks for the plan and the provisional links. A few quick answers: grouped screenshots by subsystem are ideal for our reviewers (so an "IAM" ZIP, a "KMS" ZIP, etc.). Hashed identifiers are acceptable as long as the same identifier maps consistently across artifacts.

Two small asks: please include the diagram source (Visio/Drawio) if possible, and in the manifest add a contact name for each artifact in case we have follow-ups. Also flag any items that are "sensitive" and should only be delivered to the security_ops inbox.

We look forward to the uploads.

—Tom

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Weller <tweller@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: artifact delivery & redaction confirmation for SIG
